questions_and_answers.question_text: Buy a reserved-seat ticket using the pattern '(Date) (time) no (train name) no shitee-seki, (destination) made (# of tickets)-mai onegai shimasu.' (Example: Juu go-nichi 3-ji no hikari, Shin Osaka made ichi-mai onegai shimasu.) Date: 2nd, Time: 11:00 a.m., Train: Kodama, Destination: Shizuoka, Tickets: 2

answers.answer_text: Futsuka gozen juuichi-ji no Kodama no shitee-seki, Shizuoka made ni-mai onegai shimasu.
